storyTitle: Show prompts in Other on the dashboard

results.title: The sidebar shows a last "Other" category when a kept prompt has no category
results.description: Verify that when at least one kept prompt has no category, the sidebar shows a last "Other" category. Covers AC-1.

steps.expected: The sidebar is displayed

steps.title: When the sidebar lists the categories
steps.expected: C1 and C2 are listed

steps.title: Then a last "Other" category is shown
steps.expected: "Other" is the last category entry, after C1 and C2

steps.title: When the user clicks "Other"
steps.expected: The Other category page opens

results.notes: Data adapted: UA = unbranded 'Electric bikes' (42c3ab89), 1 market GB (EN), 1 real category C1 = 'Commuter Electric Bikes' (no C2 in this setup), 1 custom prompt Other on both category and type. Observed sidebar under Categories: 'Commuter Electric Bikes', then 'Other' as last entry (href /category/003f836d-...). Clicking 'Other' opens the Other category page (Identity + Sources tabs, InBrief, Top Topics in the Category). C2 ordering not verifiable with 1 real category.

results.notes: Data adapted: no unbranded analysis without an Other prompt exists in QA-GEO (only 'Electric bikes' 42c3ab89, which has 1 Other prompt, and 'kids toys' FAILED). Proxy UZ = brand analysis Nike (cce7a7dc, no OTHER question type in /scope questionStats): sidebar lists 'Overview', 'Running Shoes', 'Action Center' - no 'Other' entry (PASS on the proxy). Steps 3-4 not executed: classifying the Other-category prompt of UA in Manage Scope is saved immediately (read-only run, write guard active) and needs the next collection. Current UA Manage Scope shows the warning '1 prompt is in Other.' and the custom row 'Which electric bike brands are best for commuting in London?' with Category 'Other' / Type 'Other' (step3 screenshot). Proposed CSV change: add a precondition with an unbranded analysis UZ with no Other prompt, and run the classification part on a dedicated disposable analysis.

results.notes: Data: 'Electric bikes' Other category page, prompt 'Which electric bike brands are best for commuting in London?' (Other on both category and type, collected 20 Oct 2026). Prompts table: 1 row, badge 'Other', themes chips + '+2'. Clicking the row opens the detail panel (note: the panel is already open on the first row at page load; a click on the selected row closes it, a second click reopens it). Panel: header with prompt text + 'Other' + 'United Kingdom' badges; engine segmented control ChatGPT / Gemini; badge 'SENTIMENT - CHATGPT' (rendered uppercase of 'Sentiment - ChatGPT') Positive; THEMES chips; RESPONSE text with 'Show more'; Sources list with 'All sources 5'. Switching to Gemini updates sentiment badge ('SENTIMENT - GEMINI'), themes (4 chips vs 2), response and sources (cyclingnews.com, british360.co.uk, cyclingelectric.com vs moveelectric.com, fullycharged.com, road.cc). The 'Other Details' design frame name is not a visible label; layout matches the category detail panel. Side observation: ChatGPT source 'road.cc' displayed with its domain as title (same family as the known rospa.com placeholder title).
